summary: This RFC defines how to implement channel bindings for EAP methods, to address the lying NAS problem and the lying provider problem, in which a network access server or provider misrepresents who it is or what it offers.

eli5.summary: It lets you check that the one asking for your password is who they claim to be, so a trickster cannot say they are someone else.

questions: how to prevent a lying nas in eap
